## One MenuAPI for every server

MenuAPI 4.0 brings all versions back together under one version number. FiveM Enhanced, FiveM Legacy and RedM now always come out at the same time, with the same version.

**FiveM Enhanced and FiveM Legacy are now built from the same code.** Everything that was new in MenuAPI Enhanced, like the NUI menus, panels, themes and rebindable key bindings, now works on the Legacy runtime too.

**Menus are now always drawn with NUI.** NUI is a small web page that FiveM shows on top of the game. The old way of drawing menus with game natives is gone. Your resource needs the `ui_page` line and the `menuapi` files in its fxmanifest. The migration guide in the docs shows exactly what to add.

**RedM stays as it was**, with one fix: the default key now opens the menu again.

Coming from MenuAPI 3.x or MenuAPI Enhanced 1.x? Read the [migration guide](https://docs.vespura.com/menuapi/fivem/migration/) before updating.
